title: Scoped current-ratio health warnings to source failures
points: Step 15 now keeps clean high current ratios as operator outliers instead of publishing them as user-facing unit/scale warnings.
TPLP's 2024-12-31 current-liability subtotal is now flagged at Step 09 as a source-reported subtotal inconsistency, with visible child rows, reported subtotal, source page, and calculation evidence.

Production D1 ratios and quality flags were refreshed. The latest health matrix shows 56 open flags, 16 yellow cells, and 0 red cells across the latest 12 periods; AGP remains a known source-filing issue.
